body.title: Migration record and scans
body.summary: Regenerate docs/plans/tool-registry-migration-record.md with section 5 (one row per s9 site and tool op), extend site-list.test.ts and no-floating-promises.test.ts to the git-calls helpers and moved functions, and add migration-record.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: migration-record.test.ts: the record lists every table row and every moved site with its test
site-list.test.ts finds every site of the scan history with a row, a table entry and a registry test
the no-floating-promises scan passes over the new helpers

tests.name: migration-record.test.ts: docs/plans/tool-registry-migration-record.md lists every table row and every moved site with its test
site-list.test.ts: every site of the replacement table is a row with a tool and a registry test, and the scan finds none outside the exemptions
no-floating-promises.test.ts: the git-calls helpers and the moved functions are awaited
